visual_synopsis: Two gangsters in black shirts and gold chains sit on a brown leather sofa drinking with a thin man in a white shirt, hiring him as a hitman; he is then shown opening a case and handling a sniper rifle. The sketch moves to a bare concrete basement where a heavy man in a white shirt and striped tie sits hooded on a stool, and the 'killer' ends up aiming the rifle at him from a metre away while the gangster laughs and manhandles the captive.
